query:
SELECT 
  s.id as venda_id,
  s.saleDate,
  s.finalAmount,
  s.saleType,
  r.id as recebi_id,
  r.totalAmount as recebivel_total,
  r.receivedAmount as recebivel_recebido,
  r.status as recebivel_status
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN receivables r ON r.saleId = s.id
WHERE s.customerId = 270001
ORDER BY s.saleDate DESC;
